title: Find Peak Calling Hours for Each City
summary: Calls(caller_id,recipient_id,call_time,city) records calls, keyed by caller, recipient and timestamp. Count calls by city and hour-of-day, then return every hour tied for that city's maximum count. Output city, peak_calling_hour and number_of_calls, ordered by hour descending then city descending.
